title: 第十三章  离开公主！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林澈心里冷笑，认罪？

认个屁的罪！

什么好意？

狗屁的好意！

这里站着的每一个人，十有八九都巴不得他林澈早点死。

“皇后娘娘，臣何罪之有？”

说着，林澈不慌不忙地从怀里摸出了一本册子。

“陛下，皇后娘娘，诸位大人，臣现在就可以自证清白！”

“臣有人证，也有物证！”

林澈扬了扬手里的册子：

“这就是公主府的出入人员登记簿！”

“陛下，公主府里上上下下，所有人的出入时间，所办何事，这本册子上记得一清二楚。”

“按照孙公子说的那天，臣和丫鬟秋菊都离开了公主府。”

“可是根据这上面的记录，臣和秋菊一直未曾出府！”

“还望陛下为臣做主！”

林澈将名册交给了身旁的太监，太监又恭恭敬敬地呈给了月天帝。

月璇玑心中疑惑。

这名册明明一直放在公主府管家手里，那管家身手不弱，住的地方还有侍卫把守，怎么会跑到林澈手里去？

再者说了，今天的林澈，怎么表现得如此镇定自若？

面对帝王皇后，面对丞相，面对满朝重臣，他脸上居然看不到一丝恐惧！

光是林澈身上流露出来的这种气度，那些高高在上的大人物都未必做得到！

这三年来，林澈一直浑浑噩噩地混日子。

难道……他一直在装傻充愣，隐匿自己的才能？

月天帝接过名册，翻看了一遍上面的详细记载，然后转头看向月璇玑。

“璇玑，这个名册是你们府里的吧？”

“这出入记录记得如此详细，会不会有什么差错？”

月天帝这话问得很有水平...他把球踢给了月璇玑。

如今，林澈的生死，可以说就掌握在月璇玑的一念之间。

此刻，月璇玑心里头翻江倒海，矛盾得很。

她只想离开这个男人，跟他和离，各走各的路，可从来就没想过要把他置于死地。

毕竟国公府发起疯来，也不是好受的！

再说林澈变化如此之大，要不给他个机会？

“回禀父皇。”

月璇玑深吸一口气，终于开口了：

“这个名册正是我们公主府的，上面的记录……不会有任何问题。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Che sneered in her heart, confessing?

Just admit your guilt!

What kind intention?

Bullshit good intentions!

Everyone standing here most likely wishes that he, Lin Che, would die soon.

"Queen, what is my crime?"

With that said, Lin Che calmly took out a booklet from her arms.

"Your Majesty, the Queen, gentlemen, I can prove my innocence now!"

"I have witnesses and physical evidence!"

Lin Che raised the booklet in her hand:

"This is the register of persons entering and exiting the Princess's Mansion!"

"Your Majesty, in the princess's residence, everyone's entry and exit times and what they were doing are clearly recorded in this booklet."

"According to what Mr. Sun said that day, both the minister and the maid Qiu Ju left the princess residence."

"But according to the records here, Chen and Qiu Ju have never left the house!"

"I hope your Majesty will make the decision for you!"

Lin Che handed the list to the eunuch beside her, and the eunuch respectfully presented it to Emperor Yue Tian.

Yue Xuanji was confused.

This list has always been in the hands of the butler of the Princess Mansion. The butler is not weak in skills, and the place where he lives is guarded by guards. How could it end up in Lin Che's hands?

Besides, why did Lin Che act so calm and composed today?

Facing the emperor and queen, the prime minister, and the ministers of the dynasty, there was no trace of fear on his face!

The kind of magnanimity that Lin Che exudes may not even be achieved by those high-ranking figures!

For the past three years, Lin Che has been living in a muddleheaded way.

Could it be that...he has been pretending to be stupid and hiding his talents?

Emperor Yue Tian took the roster, read the detailed records on it, and then turned to look at Yue Xuanji.

"Xuanji, does this roster belong to your house?"

"I remember the entry and exit records in such detail. Is there any mistake?"

Emperor Yue Tian asked this question very skillfully... He kicked the ball to Yue Xuanji.

Nowadays, Lin Che's life and death can be said to be controlled by Yue Xuanji's thoughts.

At this moment, Yue Xuanji's heart was full of contradictions.

She just wanted to leave this man, make peace with him, and go their own ways, but she never thought of putting him to death.

After all, it’s not easy to go crazy when the Duke’s Mansion goes crazy!

Besides, Lin Che has changed so much, why not give him a chance?

"Reply to Father."

Yue Xuanji took a deep breath and finally spoke:

"This roster belongs to our princess's mansion, and the records on it... there won't be any problems."
